item.title: Virtual Fencing for Conservation
item.description: A roadmap for making rangelands work better for livestock and wildlife

item.title: Ranches Face a Generational Crisis. Virtual Fencing Can Help. | PERC
item.description: This emerging technology simplifies ranch management, reduces physical labor, and provides a level of flexibility that those stubborn traditional fences could never match.

item.title: Success Shouldn’t Trigger Stricter Rules | PERC
item.description: An amicus brief arguing the Ninth Circuit should reaffirm that the ESA’s experimental population program is meant to reward collaboration, not penalize it.

item.title: The Next Era of American Conservation | PERC
item.description: As we celebrate the 250th anniversary of the United States, it’s time to add a new chapter to America’s conservation legacy, with private lands, market-based tools, and bottom-up approaches at the center.

item.title: Don't Let Federal Agencies Revoke Permits Without Consequence | PERC
item.description: For American Prairie and other western ranchers, permit certainty would mean that decades-old grazing privileges on federal land would be honored as valid property rights.

item.title: Predators and Precedents: Grizzly Bears, Joe Pickett, and the Law of Delisting | PERC
item.description: This academic paper examines how popular culture, legal frameworks, and conservation science intersect to shape wildlife policy.

item.title: The Endangered Species Act Regulatory Reform Pendulum Swings Again—Possibly For the Final Time | PERC
item.description: If the courts and U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service can agree, then the regulatory pendulum might finally come to a stop.

item.title: Trading Green | PERC
item.description: How transferable tax credits supercharge conservation easements

item.title: New PERC Report: Transferable Tax Credits Expand Participation in Conservation Easements | PERC
item.description: Research shows market-based reforms make conservation easements more accessible for farmers and ranchers while protecting higher-value lands.

item.title: It’s Time to Make the Endangered Species Act Work Better for Recovery | PERC
item.description: PERC testifies before the Senate on pragmatic solutions to boost species recovery under the ESA.
